method: Source CameraRig.snap and FlightCamera; localStorage CPU double only; fixed unboosted/no-shake poses. Exact source SKY_PRESETS copied as numbers; finite projected bounds are not occlusion/visibility guarantees.
limitations: Objects can naturally leave the viewport at envelope extremes; no gameplay ranges or camera behavior were changed.
Source bloom/PMREM/texture normal maps/tone mapping/fog and actual render visibility are not validated by these CPU probes.
